events.title: Steam Next Fest is Live! (And we need your help in the dungeons)
events.summary: Hello everyone! Steam Next Fest has officially kicked off, and HELLCARD II is right in the middle of the action! events.title: Break the Demo
events.summary: Playtest gave us a treasure trove of balancing data. With that, and your feedback, we did out best to balance the game. Some team members think the game is balanced. That they have a handle on how many game breaking builds are possible. Others on the team are pretty sure they are mistaken but need help proving it. Cue this first...Break HELLCARD II Community Challenge. Your mission is simple: push the demo's cards and builds as far as they'll go. And then a bit further. Find an outrageous combo.

events.title: The Stats!
events.summary: We want Hellcard II runs to be more like adventures, leaning into the RPG aspect of the dungeon crawl. And one can't have an RPG without stats! In Hellcard, the only ways in which characters differed were their decks and, to a degree, class artifacts. In Hellcard II, we are introducing Stats - a new way to specialize your deck or pivot into an entirely different build.Each class begins with unique base values.
